walks.name: Rockridge
walks.vibe: Busy, friendly College Ave with bookstores, a library and a food hall.

start.n: Rockridge BART is about 10 minutes north on College Ave.

stops.n: [Verified online Nov 20] Hand a printed, dated flyer to staff. They review each one, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself. They aim to answer within 48 hours.
[Address checked Nov 20] Ask at the counter about the window or a board.
[Address checked Nov 20] On the team's sheet for Nov 21. A food hall with a coffee bar and bakery inside. Ask a manager before leaving anything.
[Address checked Nov 20] A pastry, Wed to Sun. Bad Walter's ice cream is right next door.
[Unconfirmed] Independent bookstore. It moved here after a 2024 fire, so check it's still at 6022 before you go. Ask at the counter.

bonus.n: Keep going north on College Ave.

walks.name: Temescal
walks.vibe: Creative Telegraph Ave strip with a tiny alley of indie shops.

start.n: Buses run along Telegraph. MacArthur BART is about 15 minutes south.

stops.n: [Verified online Nov 20] Hand a printed, dated flyer to staff. They review each one, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
[Address checked Nov 20] Small shops along 49th St. Ask each one kindly for a window spot.
[Address checked Nov 20] Ice cream in the alley.

stops.t: East Bay Depot for Creative Reuse
stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Nonprofit reuse store, open Wed to Sun from noon. Ask if they take paper flyers for local events.
Rest by the creek. On Sundays the farmers market runs a short walk down the path, 9 to 1.

walks.name: Grand Lake
walks.vibe: An old theatre, a co-op bakery and a bookstore, steps from the lake.

start.n: Buses run on Grand Ave. Street parking is metered.

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Long-time used and new bookstore. Ask about a board or the window.
[Verified online Nov 20] Hand a printed, dated flyer to staff. They review each one, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Worker-owned co-op bakery, closed Mondays. Ask if they have a community board.
[Unconfirmed] Walk the block and ask friendly shops for window space.
stops.a: Lakeshore Ave and Trestle Glen Rd, Oakland, CA

stops.n: Sit for a minute. On Saturdays the farmers market is right here, 9 to 2.
stops.a: Grand Ave and Lakeshore Ave, Oakland, CA

walks.name: Chinatown
walks.vibe: Lively streets, a library and a cultural center in one plaza.

start.n: Lake Merritt and 12th St BART are each 5 to 10 minutes away.
start.a: 9th St and Webster St, Oakland, CA

stops.n: [Verified online Nov 20] Suite 190 in Pacific Renaissance Plaza, closed Sundays. On the team's sheet for Nov 21. Hand a printed, dated flyer to staff. They review each one, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Upstairs in the same plaza, open Wed to Sat, 12 to 5. Ask if they share community events.
[Unconfirmed] Ask shops around the fountain courtyard for window space.
[Unconfirmed] Bakeries and markets between 8th and 10th St. Ask politely and keep it short.
stops.a: Webster St and 8th St, Oakland, CA

stops.n: Half the park is closed for construction until fall 2027. Rest in the open half, by the playgrounds.
stops.a: 10th St and Harrison St, Oakland, CA

walks.name: Uptown and Downtown
walks.vibe: From the theatres to City Hall to the Main Library, ending at the lake.

start.n: Start right at the BART exit on Broadway.

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Cafe and event space. Ask if they have a board for local events.
Rest stop by City Hall, not a place to post. Nothing on poles or signs here.
stops.a: Frank H. Ogawa Plaza, Oakland, CA

stops.n: [Verified online Nov 20] Open Sundays too. Hand a printed, dated flyer to staff. They review each one, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
Two blocks east. Rest by the water to finish.
stops.a: Lakeside Dr and 14th St, Oakland, CA

walks.name: Piedmont Ave
walks.vibe: Leafy, walkable avenue with bookstores, a cinema and old-school ice cream.

start.n: MacArthur BART is about 15 minutes west.
start.a: Piedmont Ave and 40th St, Oakland, CA

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Independent bookstore. Ask about window space.
[Verified online Nov 20] Just off the avenue. Hand a printed, dated flyer to staff. They review each one, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
[Address checked Nov 20] Oakland's oldest working cinema. Ask if they post local events.
[Unconfirmed] Used and new books. Ask at the counter.
[Address checked Nov 20] Classic ice cream to end the walk.

bonus.n: For a quiet walk after, the cemetery is at the north end. Walking visits Wed, Sat and Sun only, and you sign in at the gate.

walks.name: Emeryville
walks.vibe: An open-air shopping street, then a busy food hall.

start.n: On the team's sheet for Nov 21. MacArthur BART is a short bus ride away.

stops.n: [Unconfirmed] Big chain stores rarely take flyers, so look for small, local shops and ask.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Japanese supermarket, open 9 to 10 daily. Ask at customer service.
[Address checked Nov 20] On the team's sheet for Nov 21. Ask stall owners one by one, and ask the market office before posting in shared areas.
[Address checked Nov 20] Grab food and sit in the hall. Open daily from 10.

bonus.n: A separate trip, about 20 minutes inland: a co-op bakery.

walks.name: Old Oakland to the Waterfront
walks.vibe: Historic blocks downhill to Jack London Square.

start.n: 12th St BART is a few blocks north.

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Run by Friends of the Oakland Public Library. Ask if they post community events.
[Unconfirmed] Fridays only, 8 to 2, so skip it on other days. Chat with shoppers and ask nearby shops for windows.
[Address checked Nov 20] Food hall in a historic building at 9th and Washington. Ask a manager about notices.
Rest stop by the water, not a place to post. Sunday market here, 11 to 4.

walks.name: Lake Merritt
walks.vibe: A calm lakeside loop past gardens, with a bookshop on Grand Ave.

start.n: 19th St BART is about 10 minutes away.
start.a: Grand Ave and Harrison St, Oakland, CA

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Bookshop and bar that hosts readings. Opens at 4 on weekdays. Ask about a board or the window.
[Unconfirmed] Ask small shops between Harrison and Euclid for window space.
stops.a: Grand Ave and Euclid Ave, Oakland, CA

stops.n: Walk the gardens. The halls are a rental venue, so don't expect a public board.
Sit on the grass by the bandstand and watch the lake.
stops.a: Bellevue Ave and Grand Ave, Oakland, CA

walks.name: Dimond to Laurel
walks.vibe: Neighborhood MacArthur Blvd with a grocer, laundromat, yoga studio and cafe.

start.n: At Fruitvale Ave and MacArthur Blvd.

stops.n: [Verified online Nov 20] Hand a printed, dated flyer to staff. They review each one, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Locally owned grocer since 1994. Ask customer service.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Big attended laundromat. People wait here, so ask staff if you can pin one up.
[Address checked Nov 20] Coffee and a sit-down.
[Address checked Nov 20] A yoga studio, a natural fit. Ask the front desk.

walks.name: Fruitvale
walks.vibe: A transit village plaza with a library and a market.

start.n: The village plaza is right outside the station.
start.a: E 12th St and 34th Ave, Oakland, CA

stops.n: [Verified online Nov 20] Suite 271 in Fruitvale Village, open Sundays too. Hand a printed, dated flyer to staff. They review each one, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
[Unconfirmed] Ask shops around the plaza for window space. Spanish flyers help here.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. The community nonprofit that runs the market. An office, so ask at the front desk if they share local events.
[Hours checked Nov 20] Tue and Thu 11 to 7, Sun 8 to 3:30. Grab a snack and chat.
stops.a: E 12th St and 34th Ave, Oakland, CA

walks.name: Montclair Village
walks.vibe: A small hill village with a bookstore and a Sunday market.

start.t: La Salle Ave and Moraga Ave
start.n: Best by car or bus. The Sunday market is right here, 9 to 1.
start.a: La Salle Ave and Moraga Ave, Oakland, CA

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Right across the street, closed Mondays. Ask at the counter.
[Unconfirmed] Small local shops on La Salle and Mountain. Ask for window space.
stops.a: La Salle Ave and Mountain Blvd, Oakland, CA

stops.n: [Verified online Nov 20] Closed Sundays, when the market runs, so drop it off on another day. Hand a printed, dated flyer to staff. They review each one, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
A green park a short walk up Moraga Ave.
stops.a: Moraga Ave and Thornhill Dr, Oakland, CA

walks.name: West Oakland
walks.vibe: A worker co-op grocer, a library and a new market hall.

start.n: Start at the station on 7th St.
start.a: 7th St and Mandela Pkwy, Oakland, CA

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Worker-owned grocery across from BART. Ask if they have a community board.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. A local cafe. Ask about a board or the window.
[Address checked Nov 20] A food hall with coffee and more. On Sundays 10 to 2 the farmers market runs at 18th and Peralta.
[Verified online Nov 20] Hand a printed, dated flyer to staff. They review each one, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.

bonus.n: Rest in the park by the library.
